title: Chemical Storage & Reagent Cabinets: Prepositions of Place
workplace_track: Hazardous Reagents, Solvent Recovery & Lab Safety
description: Accurately locate chemical reagent bottles, spill kits, eyewash stations, and solvent waste containers using English prepositions of place.
learning_objectives: Use prepositions of place (in, on, under, between, next to, inside, behind) accurately
Differentiate between 'in the cabinet' vs 'on the shelf' vs 'under the fume hood'
Avoid common Czenglish spatial confusion (e.g. *on the lab* vs in the lab)

questions.prompt: All flammable solvent bottles must be stored _____ the yellow explosion-proof safety cabinet.

explanations.correct: 'inside' (or 'in') correctly denotes enclosed storage inside a safety cabinet.
explanations.wrong_A: 'on' would mean on top of the external roof of the cabinet.
explanations.wrong_C: 'between' requires two separate objects or reference points.
explanations.wrong_D: 'along' describes movement parallel to a line.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'uvnitř skříně'. Use 'inside' or 'in' for closed storage cabinets.
questions.workplace_track: Hazardous Reagents, Solvent Recovery & Lab Safety

questions.prompt: The laboratory emergency shower is located right _____ the main cleanroom exit door.

explanations.wrong_A: 'among' is used with three or more objects.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'vedle dveří'. Use 'next to' or 'beside', not *next the door*.
questions.workplace_track: Hazardous Reagents, Solvent Recovery & Lab Safety

questions.prompt: Place the volumetric flask _____ the analytical balance pan before pressing the tare button.

explanations.correct: 'on' designates contact with a horizontal flat surface (the balance pan).

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'na misku vah'. In English, surface contact requires 'on'.
questions.workplace_track: Hazardous Reagents, Solvent Recovery & Lab Safety

questions.prompt: The acid waste container is positioned _____ the workbench to prevent accidental spills from falling.

explanations.wrong_A: 'above' would mean higher than the bench.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'pod pracovním stolem'. In English: 'under the workbench'.
questions.workplace_track: Hazardous Reagents, Solvent Recovery & Lab Safety

questions.prompt: The chemical spill kit is mounted on the wall _____ the solvent cabinet and the eyewash station.

explanations.correct: 'between' is used for an intermediate position connecting two distinct reference points.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'mezi skříní a stanicí'. Position between two items is 'between'.
questions.workplace_track: Hazardous Reagents, Solvent Recovery & Lab Safety

questions.prompt: Keep all volatile reagents _____ the fume hood sash during extraction.

explanations.correct: 'behind the sash' indicates inside the ventilated fume hood area, shielded by the glass window.

questions.cz_learning_point: Chemical safety requires reagents to be placed 'behind the fume hood sash' (za ochranným sklem digestoře).
questions.workplace_track: Hazardous Reagents, Solvent Recovery & Lab Safety

questions.prompt: The concentrated nitric acid is stored on the lowest shelf, _____ the organic solvents.

explanations.correct: 'away from' indicates physical separation to prevent hazardous chemical reactions.

questions.cz_learning_point: In chemical segregation, acids must be stored 'away from' (odděleně / mimo) incompatible bases and organic solvents.
questions.workplace_track: Hazardous Reagents, Solvent Recovery & Lab Safety

questions.prompt: The glass desiccator is located _____ the top shelf of cabinet C-3.

explanations.correct: Objects resting on horizontal shelving take 'on': 'on the top shelf'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'at the top shelf' is non-standard for resting items.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'na horní polici'. English uses 'on the shelf', never *in the shelf*.
questions.workplace_track: Hazardous Reagents, Solvent Recovery & Lab Safety

questions.prompt: Do not leave used pipette tips _____ the laminar flow hood bench when you finish testing.

explanations.correct: 'on' designates resting on the surface of the bench.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'nenechávejte na stole'. Surface contact is 'on the bench'.
questions.workplace_track: Hazardous Reagents, Solvent Recovery & Lab Safety

questions.prompt: The secondary containment tray is positioned _____ each 25-liter solvent carboy.

explanations.correct: 'underneath' (or 'under') indicates directly beneath the container to catch drips.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'pod nádobou'. 'Underneath' indicates directly below to catch leaks.
